description: This Swift source file defines a ViewModifier named GatewayTrustPromptAlert which presents an alert prompt to trust a gateway during a TLS connection. It interacts with a GatewayConnectionController to manage trust prompts and provides an extension to View for easier attachment of this alert.

classes.name: GatewayTrustPromptAlert
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that presents an alert asking the user whether to trust a gateway during a TLS connection, based on a trust prompt managed by GatewayConnectionController.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Constructs the view body that overlays an alert based on the current trust prompt.

methods.name: gatewayTrustPromptAlert
methods.description: An extension method on View to apply the GatewayTrustPromptAlert modifier.
